events.name: Ashes to Ashes

Guest starring David Bradley and Rory Kinnear

Meanwhile, Sam is left in charge at the Solana, and cannot resist trying to make some extra cash by organising a raffle in Neptunes, and anticipation is in the air as Joyce and Monty's big day arrives. However, things go from bad to worse when Monty finds himself, and the guests, in quite a predicament, and it's up to Kenneth to save the day
